_note: Each case edits tests/fixtures/quayside.page.json and states whether the build passes. Paths are dotted, numbers index lists (sections.2.data.logos). Edits: set, replace (path: [old, new]), append, delete. Optional: files (name: text, written next to page.json), siblings (identical sites next to the page), prior_report (a build-report.json already in the output folder), lint (false skips lint on a passing case). Emoji, dashes, arrows and banned words are written as \u escapes so this file itself follows AGENTS.md.
